contentItem.title: 比较五种正多面体的边长
contentItem.englishTitle: To set out the sides of the five figures and to compare them with one another.

revision.changeSummary: Imported Heath source and machine-assisted Chinese draft. No mathematical or editorial review is implied.

surfaces.text: To set out the sides of the five figures and to compare them with one another.
在同一个给定球内作五种正多面体，确定并比较它们的棱长。

Let AB, the diameter of the given sphere, be set out, and let it be cut at C so that AC is equal to CB, and at D so that AD is double of DB; let the semicircle AEB be described on AB, from C, D let CE, DF be drawn at right angles to AB, and let AF, FB, EB be joined.
设 AB 为给定球的直径；在点 C 处分割 AB，使 AC 等于 CB，再取点 D，使 AD 等于 DB 的两倍。以 AB 为直径作半圆 AEB；过 C、D 分别作 CE、DF 垂直于 AB，并连接 AF、FB、EB。
Then, since AD is double of DB, therefore AB is triple of BD.
AD是DB的两倍 所以AB是BD的三倍
Convertendo, therefore, BA is one and a half times AD.
因此,BA是AD的1.5倍

But, as BA is to AD, so is the square on BA to the square on AF, [[V. Def. 9](/principles/euclid-5-def-9), [VI. 8](/principles/euclid-6-8)] for the triangle AFB is equiangular with the triangle AFD; therefore the square on BA is one and a half times the square on AF.
但是,BA比AD的比例等于BA比正方形之比AF,]三角形AFB是同三角形AFD的对角;因此,BA比正方形等于AF比正方形的1.5倍 [ [V. Def. 9](/principles/euclid-5-def-9) [VI. 8](/principles/euclid-6-8)
But the square on the diameter of the sphere is also one and a half times the square on the side of the pyramid. [[XIII. 13](/principles/euclid-13-13)]
但球体直径的正方形 也是金字塔边正方形的1.5倍 [[XIII. 13](/principles/euclid-13-13)]
And AB is the diameter of the sphere; therefore AF is equal to the side of the pyramid.
AB是球的直径, 因此AF等于金字塔的侧面。
Again, since AD is double of DB, therefore AB is triple of BD.
AD是DB的两倍,因此AB是BD的三倍。
But, as AB is to BD, so is the square on AB to the square on BF; [[VI. 8](/principles/euclid-6-8), [V. Def. 9](/principles/euclid-5-def-9)] therefore the square on AB is triple of the square on BF.
但是,AB对BD的比等于AB对正方形的比,BF对正方形的比,因此,AB对AB的比是正方形对BF的比的三倍 [ [VI. 8](/principles/euclid-6-8) [V. Def. 9](/principles/euclid-5-def-9)
But the square on the diameter of the sphere is also triple of the square on the side of the cube. [[XIII. 15](/principles/euclid-13-15)]
但球的直径是正方形 离立方体的3倍 [[XIII. 15](/principles/euclid-13-15)]
And AB is the diameter of the sphere; therefore BF is the side of the cube.
AB是球的直径, 因此BF是立方体的侧面。
And, since AC is equal to CB, therefore AB is double of BC.
AC等于CB 所以AB等于BC的两倍
But, as AB is to BC, so is the square on AB to the square on BE; therefore the square on AB is double of the square on BE.
但是,AB对BC的比等于AB对正方形的比,BE对正方形的比;因此,AB对AB的比是BE对正方形的比的两倍
But the square on the diameter of the sphere is also double of the square on the side of the octahedron. [[XIII. 14](/principles/euclid-13-14)]
但是球体直径的正方形 也是八面体侧的正方形的两倍。 [[XIII. 14](/principles/euclid-13-14)]
And AB is the diameter of the given sphere; therefore BE is the side of the octahedron.
AB是给定球的直径, 因此, BE 是八面体的侧面 。
Next, let AG be drawn from the point A at right angles to the straight line AB, let AG be made equal to AB, let GC be joined, and from H let HK be drawn perpendicular to AB.
接下来,从直角时的A点到AB线,再从AG点到AG线,再从AB线到GC线,再从H线到HK线,再从H线到AB线,再到AB线。
Then, since GA is double of AC, for GA is equal to AB, and, as GA is to AC, so is HK to KC, therefore HK is also double of KC.
GA是AC的两倍,GA等于AB,GA对AC的比等于HK对KC的比,因此HK也是KC的两倍；GA 与 AC 之比等于 HK 与 KC 之比。
Therefore the square on HK is quadruple of the square on KC; therefore the squares on HK, KC, that is, the square on HC, is five times the square on KC.
因此,HK比正方形是KC比正方形的三倍;因此,HK比KC比正方形比正方形是5倍。（相关点与线段：HC）
But HC is equal to CB; therefore the square on BC is five times the square on CK.
但HC等于CB,因此BC的正方形是CK的正方形的5倍。
And, since AB is double of CB, and, in them, AD is double of DB, therefore the remainder BD is double of the remainder DC.
AB是CB的两倍,其中AD是DB的两倍,因此其余BD是其余DC的两倍。
Therefore BC is triple of CD; therefore the square on BC is nine times the square on CD.
因此,BC是CD的三倍;因此,BC的正方形是CD的正方形的9倍。
But the square on BC is five times the square on CK; therefore the square on CK is greater than the square on CD; therefore CK is greater than CD.
但BC比正方形是CK的5倍;因此,CK比正方形比CD比正方形;CK比CD大于CD。
Let CL be made equal to CK, from L let LM be drawn at right angles to AB, and let MB be joined.
让CL等于CK,从L到LM,在直角到AB之间抽,让MB连接。
Now, since the square on BC is five times the square on CK, and AB is double of BC, and KL double of CK, therefore the square on AB is five times the square on KL.
现在,BC正方形是CK正方形的5倍,ABBCBC2倍,CKKLKLKLKLAB5倍。
But the square on the diameter of the sphere is also five times the square on the radius of the circle from which the icosahedron has been described. [[XIII. 16, Por.](/principles/euclid-13-16)]
但球体直径的正方形 也是圆形半径的5倍, 以内沙赫德龙为根据。 [[XIII. 16, Por.](/principles/euclid-13-16)]

And AB is the diameter of the sphere; therefore KL is the radius of the circle from which the icosahedron has been described; therefore KL is a side of the hexagon in the said circle. [[IV. 15, Por.](/principles/euclid-4-15)]
AB是球的直径, 因此KL是圆的半径, 以此来描述象牙圆; 因此, KL 是圆中六边形的一面。 [[IV. 15, Por.](/principles/euclid-4-15)]

And, since the diameter of the sphere is made up of the side of the hexagon and two of the sides of the decagon inscribed in the same circle, [[XIII. 16, Por.](/principles/euclid-13-16)] and AB is the diameter of the sphere, while KL is a side of the hexagon, and AK is equal to LB, therefore each of the straight lines AK, LB is a side of the decagon inscribed in the circle from which the icosahedron has been described.
由于球的直径由六角和十角两面组成, 同一圆内刻有AB, 球的直径是KL, 而AK是六角的一面, AK等于LB, 因此, AK, LB 直线都是 内角所标出圆形的十角的一面。 [[XIII. 16, Por.](/principles/euclid-13-16)]

And, since LB belongs to a decagon, and ML to a hexagon, for ML is equal to KL, since it is also equal to HK, being the same distance from the centre, and each of the straight lines HK, KL is double of KC, therefore MB belongs to a pentagon. [[XIII. 10](/principles/euclid-13-10)]
由于LB属于十边形,ML属于六边形,ML等于KL,因为它也等于HK,与中线的距离相同,HK,KL直线每条线都是KC的两倍,因此MB线属于五边形。 [[XIII. 10](/principles/euclid-13-10)]
But the side of the pentagon is the side of the icosahedron; [[XIII. 16](/principles/euclid-13-16)] therefore MB belongs to the icosahedron.
但五角形的侧面是象牙面的侧面,因此MB是象牙面的。 [[XIII. 16](/principles/euclid-13-16)]

Now, since FB is a side of the cube, let it be cut in extreme and mean ratio at N, and let NB be the greater segment; therefore NB is a side of the dodecahedron. [[XIII. 17, Por.](/principles/euclid-13-17)]
现在,既然FB是立方体的一面, 让它在黄金分割 时切除为N, 让NB 成为更大的数量段; 因此, NB 是十二面体的一面 。 [[XIII. 17, Por.](/principles/euclid-13-17)]

And, since the square on the diameter of the sphere was proved to be one and a half times the square on the side AF of the pyramid, double of the square on the side BE of the octahedron and triple of the side FB of the cube, therefore, of parts of which the square on the diameter of the sphere contains six, the square on the side of the pyramid contains four, the square on the side of the octahedron three, and the square on the side of the cube two.
并且,由于球的直径正方形是金字塔AF侧正方形的1.5倍,八面形BE侧正方形的两倍,方块FB的三倍,因此,球的直径正方形的部件有6个,金字塔侧正方形的有4个,八面形3的正方形个,立方体2的正方形个。

Therefore the square on the side of the pyramid is fourthirds of the square on the side of the octahedron, and double of the square on the side of the cube; and the square on the side of the octahedron is one and a half times the square on the side of the cube.
因此,金字塔边的正方形是八面形边的正方形的4/3,方块边的正方形是2倍;八面形边的正方形是立方体边的1倍半。
The said sides, therefore, of the three figures, I mean the pyramid, the octahedron and the cube, are to one another in rational ratios.
因此,在这三个数字中,我指的是金字塔,八面形和立方体,在有理个比中相互对立。

But the remaining two, I mean the side of the icosahedron and the side of the dodecahedron, are not in rational ratios either to one another or to the aforesaid sides; for they are irrational, the one being minor [[XIII. 16](/principles/euclid-13-16)] and the other an apotome [[XIII. 17](/principles/euclid-13-17)].
但剩下的两个,我的意思是, 面面和面面, 并不是有理个比例, 要么是相互,要么是上述两面;；这里涉及截差无理线段。 [[XIII. 16](/principles/euclid-13-16)] [[XIII. 17](/principles/euclid-13-17)]
That the side MB of the icosahedron is greater than the side NB of the dodecahedron we can prove thus.
MB面体比NB面体大 我们能证明这一点
For, since the triangle FDB is equiangular with the triangle FAB, [[VI. 8](/principles/euclid-6-8)] proportionally, as DB is to BF, so is BF to BA. [[VI. 4](/principles/euclid-6-4)]
因为三角形FDB是同三角形FAB的对角形,因此,DB比BF比BA的比例是相等的；DB 与 BF 之比等于 BF 与 BA 之比。 [[VI. 8](/principles/euclid-6-8)] [[VI. 4](/principles/euclid-6-4)]

And, since the three straight lines are proportional, as the first is to the third, so is the square on the first to the square on the second; [[V. Def. 9](/principles/euclid-5-def-9), [VI. 20, Por.](/principles/euclid-6-20)] therefore, as DB is to BA, so is the square on DB to the square on BF; therefore, inversely, as AB is to BD, so is the square on FB to the square on BD.
由于这三条直线是成比例,第一对三的比等于第一对正方形对第二对正方形;因此,DB对BA的比等于DB对正方形对BF的比;因此,AB对BD的比等于FB对正方形对BD的比 [ [V. Def. 9](/principles/euclid-5-def-9) [VI. 20, Por.](/principles/euclid-6-20)
But AB is triple of BD; therefore the square on FB is triple of the square on BD.
但AB是BD的三倍,因此FB的正方形是BD的正方形的三倍。

But the square on AD is also quadruple of the square on DB, for AD is double of DB; therefore the square on AD is greater than the square on FB; therefore AD is greater than FB; therefore AL is by far greater than FB.
但是,AD比正方形比DB是三倍,AD比DB是两倍;因此,AD比FB比正方形比正方形;AD比FB,AD比FB,AL远远大于FB。

And, when AL is cut in extreme and mean ratio, KL is the greater segment, inasmuch as LK belongs to a hexagon, and KA to a decagon; [[XIII. 9](/principles/euclid-13-9)] and, when FB is cut in extreme and mean ratio, NB is the greater segment; therefore KL is greater than NB.
当黄金分割削减AL时,KL是较大的数量部分,因为LK是六边形,KA是十边形;当黄金分割削减FB时,NB是较大的数量部分;因此,KL是大于NB。 [[XIII. 9](/principles/euclid-13-9)]
But KL is equal to LM; therefore LM is greater than NB.
但KL等于LM,因此LM大于NB。
Therefore MB, which is a side of the icosahedron, is by far greater than NB which is a side of the dodecahedron. Q. E. D.
因此,MB是象牙面的一面,远远大于NB,是十二面体的一面。
I say next that no other figure, besides the said five figures, can be constructed which is contained by equilateral and equiangular figures equal to one another.
我接下来要说,除了上述五位数字之外,没有其他一位数字是用等边和等角数字组成的。
For a solid angle cannot be constructed with two triangles, or indeed planes.
立体角度不能用两个三角形来构造,甚至不能用平面来构建。

With three triangles the angle of the pyramid is constructed, with four the angle of the octahedron, and with five the angle of the icosahedron; but a solid angle cannot be formed by six equilateral and equiangular triangles placed together at one point, for, the angle of the equilateral triangle being two-thirds of a right angle, the six will be equal to four right angles: which is impossible, for any solid angle is contained by angles less than four right angles. [[XI. 21](/principles/euclid-11-21)]
有了三个三角形,金字塔的角度就建好了,四个角是八面形,五个角是二面形;但是一个固角不能由六个等边形和等角三角形组成,一个点是等边三角形角角,即直角角的三分之二,那么,6角等于4 直角角,这是不可能的,因为任何固角都由不到4 直角角的角组成。 [[XI. 21](/principles/euclid-11-21)]
For the same reason, neither can a solid angle be constructed by more than six plane angles.
出于同样的原因,一个立体角度也不能用6 平面多个角度构建。
By three squares the angle of the cube is contained, but by four it is impossible for a solid angle to be contained, for they will again be four right angles.
3,正方形时方格被控制,但4时,不可能固定方位被控制,因为它们将再次为4,直角。

By three equilateral and equiangular pentagons the angle of the dodecahedron is contained; but by four such it is impossible for any solid angle to be contained, for, the angle of the equilateral pentagon being a right angle and a fifth, the four angles will be greater than four right angles: which is impossible.
以三个等边形和等角形为单位,则含有十二面形的角;但以四个等角为单位,则不可能包含任何固角,因为等角形的角为直角和5, 四个角将大于四面直角:这是不可能做到的。
Neither again will a solid angle be contained by other polygonal figures by reason of the same absurdity.
由于同样荒谬的原因,其他多边形数字也不会形成一个坚实的视角。
Therefore etc. Q. E. D.
因此,等等,证毕。
Lemma. But that the angle of the equilateral and equiangular pentagon is a right angle and a fifth we must prove thus.
柠檬,但等边和角五角形的角是直角和5,我们必须证明这一点。
Let ABCDE be an equilateral and equiangular pentagon, let the circle ABCDE be circumscribed about it, let its centre F be taken, and let FA, FB, FC, FD, FE be joined.
让ABCDE成为一种等边和角五角形,让ABCDE圆圈加以限制,让其中心F被采纳,让FA、FB、FC、FD、FE被连接。
Therefore they bisect the angles of the pentagon at A, B, C, D, E.
因此,它们将五角形的角分为A、B、C、D、E。

And, since the angles at F are equal to four right angles and are equal, therefore one of them, as the angle AFB, is one right angle less a fifth; therefore the remaining angles FAB, ABF consist of one right angle and a fifth.
F时的角等于4 直角,因此其中的一个角等于AFB, 即1 直角减去五分之一; 因此,其余的角为FAB, ABF包括1 直角和1/5。
But the angle FAB is equal to the angle FBC; therefore the whole angle ABC of the pentagon consists of one right angle and a fifth. Q. E. D.
但FAB角等于FBC角;因此,五角形的整个ABC角包括1 直角和1/5。
